# telnyx_email_suppressions (Data Source)

Lists email suppressions, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_email_suppression`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_email_suppressions" "bounces" {
  filter_reason = "hard_bounce"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_created_after` (String)
- `filter_created_before` (String)
- `filter_domain_id` (String)
- `filter_reason` (String) One of `hard_bounce`, `invalid`, `manual_block`, `spam_complaint`, `unsubscribe`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `email_suppressions` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_suppressions))

<a id="nestedatt--email_suppressions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_suppressions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `domain_id` (String) `null` ⇒ account scope. Stored on the row; exposed here.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional expiration time. An active row stops matching send-time suppression checks as soon as `expires_at <= now()`. A maintenance worker later transitions the row to `status: expired` and appends an `expired` audit event (normally within 15 minutes).
- `from` (String) `null` ⇒ not address-scope. (schema: from_address)
- `group_id` (String) `null` ⇒ global; set ⇒ group-scoped opt-out.
- `id` (String)
- `reason` (String)
- `record_type` (String) View-only discriminator.
- `scope` (String) Derived server-side from `domain_id`/`from`; never trusted from the caller.
- `source` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `to` (String) Normalized recipient. (schema: to_address)
- `updated_at` (String)
